title: snapshot.snapshot_thermal payload
description: M5-A2 § thermal.* family + M4 § M9 firehose surface. Placeholder payload at M5 (placeholder=true); M16 + M19 fill by_actor + heat_grid as the thermal kernel ladders up. Fires at scenario start and on every objective transition. Parallels snapshot_atmospherics + snapshot_shield + snapshot_environment_signal.

placeholder.description: True when emitted by M4/M5 with a stub payload; M16/M19 producer fills real data and clears this flag.

by_actor.description: Per-actor thermal state: { actor_id, signature_k, heat_emission_w, heat_sink_w }. signature_k is the Kelvin signature visible to IR seekers + thermal sights. heat_emission_w + heat_sink_w drive atmosphere heat exchange per ONI-style modelling.

heat_grid.description: Optional sparse-grid sample of per-tile thermal state: { tile: [x, y], temperature_k, conductivity_w_per_mk }. Populated for M9 firehose only when terrain heat-exchange ticks fire.
